name: Uther's Tomb
summary: On Sorrow Hill in the Western Plaguelands, Uther's Tomb remains untouched by the blight. His followers raised it after Arthas slew him near Andorhal.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Blight
sections.body:
South of Andorhal's ruins, Uther's Tomb marks the resting place of Uther, who founded the Knights of the Silver Hand. After Lordaeron fell, he made his last stand in Andorhal. There he defended King Terenas Menethil II's urn of ashes from Prince Arthas Menethil and the Scourge.

Arthas killed his former mentor and took the urn to carry Kel'Thuzad's remains. Surviving soldiers recovered Uther's body and laid him in a stone sanctuary. Though the surrounding land is corrupted, the tomb remains untouched by decay under High Priest Thel'danis's watch.

sections.title: The Lightbringer's Legacy
sections.body: The Path of Uther leads to a grand stone effigy of the paladin. A tome of the Holy Light rests in one hand, and his warhammer in the other. Pilgrims brave these roads to pay homage, pray, or reflect on the devotion that shaped the first paladins.

faq.q: Who is buried in this tomb?
faq.answer: Uther the Lightbringer rests here. He founded and commanded the Knights of the Silver Hand, the first paladin order in human history. Before Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, he mentored Prince Arthas Menethil.

Uther fell in Andorhal, slain by his former student, Arthas Menethil. Arthas had returned from Northrend as a death knight. Uther died defending the urn that held the ashes of Arthas's father, King Terenas Menethil II.
High Priest Thel'danis cares for the monument and keeps a quiet, sacred vigil over Uther's resting place. He braves the surrounding undead to keep the shrine a sanctuary of the Light.

faq.q: Why isn't the tomb corrupted by the plague?
faq.answer: Uther's memory and the enduring power of the Holy Light consecrate the grounds. Sorrow Hill's surrounding forests have withered and rotted, while the shrine remains an unbroken sanctuary against the blight.

angles.text: As a paladin, standing before Uther's statue honors the father of the order. His sacrifice embodies the virtues of the Silver Hand.
As an Alliance traveler, this tomb recalls Lordaeron's fallen legacy. It offers a place for quiet reflection amid the horrors of the Plaguelands.
